en.chat_emergency: This may be a medical emergency. Call your local emergency number or go to the nearest hospital now. AI guidance only. Not a medical diagnosis.

en.chat_followup: Could you tell me which symptoms or health topic you mean? For example: "symptoms of diabetes", "I have fever and headache", or "what is paracetamol used for".

en.chat_symptom_intro: Your symptoms may be related to these possible conditions: {predictions}. Please arrange medical advice if symptoms persist or worsen.
en.symptom_match_intro: Your symptom pattern has been matched with {disease} as one possible condition.
en.advice_note: Please arrange prompt medical evaluation, especially if symptoms worsen, persist, or you cannot keep fluids down.

en.low_confidence_note: This match has low confidence. It's best to get a doctor's opinion rather than rely on this alone.
en.disclaimer: AI guidance only. Not a medical diagnosis. Consult a physician for emergencies.
